title: securidaca volubilis var. mollis
intro: Securidaca volubilis var. mollis, commonly known as the "Wild Potato" or "Sweet Potato Bush", is a type of plant that belongs to the family Polygalaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of Securidaca volubilis var. mollis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
